functions.name: uid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select 
  coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.sub', true), ''),
    (nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '')::jsonb ->> 'sub')
  )::uuid
$function$

functions.name: share_technology_next_snapshot
technology_next_shared_immutable
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.technology_next_shared_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Shared snapshots are immutable; capture a new request'; END $function$

functions.name: technology_next_sharing_capability
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.technology_next_sharing_capability(target_org uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_members m JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=m.organization_id
  JOIN public.profiles owner_plan ON owner_plan.id=o.owner_user_id
  JOIN public.profiles actor_plan ON actor_plan.id=m.user_id
  WHERE m.organization_id=target_org AND m.user_id=auth.uid()
  AND m.role IN('owner','admin','manager','member','viewer') AND owner_plan.plan='business' AND actor_plan.plan='business'
 ) THEN 'technology-next-sharing-private-1' ELSE NULL END;
$function$

indexes.name: technology_next_shared_snapshots_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX technology_next_shared_snapshots_pkey ON public.technology_next_shared_snapshots USING btree (id)

triggers.name: technology_next_shared_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER technology_next_shared_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.technology_next_shared_snapshots FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION technology_next_shared_immutable()
